findings.source: psm.sol sellGem: gemAmt18 = mul(gemAmt, to18ConversionFactor); fee = mul(gemAmt18, tin) / WAD; vat.frob(ilk, ..., int256(gemAmt18), int256(gemAmt18)); vat.move(address(this), vow, mul(fee, RAY)); daiJoin.exit(usr, daiAmt)
findings.issue: All of gemJoin, vat, vow, daiJoin, ilk, dai and to18ConversionFactor are immutables, 0 before deployment: every call goes to 0x0 and, with the conversion factor 0, gemAmt18, fee and daiAmt fold to 0 (tin and tout are never read).

notes: No loops. Checked against the source: rely/deny with Rely/Deny events, hope/nope forwarding to the vat, file with 'tin'/'tout' and 'DssPsm/file-unrecognized-param', sellGem's join/frob/move/exit sequence and SellGem event, buyGem's transferFrom with 'DssPsm/failed-transfer', join/frob/exit/move and BuyGem event; the order of calls and their arguments match the source under zero immutables.
summary: Faithful; the zero immutables (including the decimals conversion factor) reduce every amount to 0, which the text shows consistently.
